recipe.description: Classic fluffy pancakes using precise scale measurements. Two bowl method for best results.
recipe.name: Fluffy Buttermilk Pancakes (Scale Demo)

steps.instruction:
In a large mixing bowl, use scale to measure:
250g all-purpose flour
25g sugar
12g baking powder
3g baking soda
5g salt

Tip: Place bowl on scale, tare to zero, then add each ingredient one at a time. You can tare between ingredients or add them all together.
steps.tips: Use the TARE button on your scale between each ingredient for accuracy, or weigh them together and subtract the bowl weight.
steps.title: Measure Dry Ingredients

steps.instruction: Whisk the dry ingredients together until evenly combined (about 30 seconds).
steps.tips: This ensures even distribution of leavening agents for uniform fluffiness.
steps.title: Whisk Dry Ingredients

steps.instruction:
In a separate bowl (or large measuring cup), use scale to measure:
360ml buttermilk (or 360g)
2 eggs (~100g)
50g melted butter
5ml vanilla extract

Tip: For liquids, 1ml ≈ 1g for water-based ingredients.
steps.tips: Melt butter in microwave (30 seconds) and let it cool slightly before adding to avoid cooking the eggs.
steps.title: Measure Wet Ingredients

steps.instruction: Whisk wet ingredients together until smooth and well combined.
steps.tips: Make sure butter is incorporated evenly.
steps.title: Whisk Wet Ingredients

steps.instruction: Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients. Gently fold together with a spatula until just combined.\n\nIMPORTANT: Do not overmix! Some lumps are OK. Overmixing makes tough pancakes.
steps.tips: Stop mixing as soon as you don't see dry flour anymore. The batter should be slightly lumpy.
steps.title: Combine Wet and Dry

steps.instruction: Let batter rest for 5 minutes. This allows the flour to hydrate and the leavening agents to activate.
steps.tips: During this time, preheat your griddle or pan to medium heat (about 190°C/375°F).
steps.title: Rest Batter

steps.instruction: Heat a non-stick griddle or large pan over MEDIUM heat. Lightly grease with butter or oil.\n\nTest: Sprinkle a few drops of water - they should sizzle and evaporate in 2-3 seconds.
steps.tips: Medium heat is key! Too hot = burnt outside, raw inside. Too cool = pale, dense pancakes.
steps.title: Preheat Griddle

steps.instruction:
Pour 1/4 cup (60ml) batter onto griddle for each pancake. Cook until bubbles form on surface and edges look set (about 2-3 minutes).

You'll know it's ready to flip when:
- Bubbles pop and don't refill
- Edges are matte (not shiny)
- Bottom is golden brown
steps.tips: Don't flip too early! Wait for the bubbles. First pancake is often a test pancake - adjust heat if needed.
steps.title: Cook First Side

steps.instruction: Flip pancakes carefully. Cook second side until golden brown (about 1-2 minutes).\n\nSecond side cooks faster than first!
steps.tips: Flip with confidence - a quick, decisive flip works best. Pancake should be puffy and spring back when touched.
steps.title: Flip and Finish

steps.instruction: Transfer cooked pancakes to a plate in a 200°F (95°C) oven to keep warm while you cook the remaining batches.\n\nRepeat steps 8-9 with remaining batter.
steps.tips: Re-grease griddle lightly between batches. Makes about 8 pancakes total.
steps.title: Keep Warm While Cooking Batches

steps.instruction:
Serve immediately with butter and maple syrup, or your favorite toppings!

Suggestions:
- Classic: Butter + maple syrup
- Fruit: Fresh berries + whipped cream
- Decadent: Chocolate chips + nutella
- Savory: Bacon + fried egg on top
steps.tips: Pancakes are best fresh off the griddle. Stack them high!
steps.title: Serve Hot
